properties.evidence: Registry serving opens each design with without_tree().without_reaching_out() (registry_http.rs:575), which is the one bit that says "this is hosted". Only one served answer reads it: artifact measurement's NoTree note in loop_status. Everything else is built without it: the handshake instructions, tools/list, get_instructions and the skills measured byte-identical between `--graph-path … --http` and `--registry-root … --http` on 0.72.0. And no argument, flag or handshake field lets the host that fronts it say which rules it has changed.
